test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 16 women can finish a task in 20 days and 20 men take 32 days to finish the same task. How many days will 8 women and 16 men take to finish the same task?
solution:
**Given:**

16 women can finish a task in 20 days.

20 men can finish the same task in 32 days.

We need to find how many days 8 women and 16 men will take to finish the task.

**Formula Used:**

Work efficiency = Total work / Time taken

Total work is constant, and efficiency is directly proportional to the number of workers and inversely proportional to the time taken.

To solve combined work, we use the Least Common Multiple (LCM) method.

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM of (16 × 20, 20 × 32)

Total work = LCM(320, 640)

Total work = 640 units.

Work done by 16 women in 1 day = Total work / Days = 640 / 20 = 32 units/day.

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = 32 / 16 = 2 units/day.

Work done by 20 men in 1 day = Total work / Days = 640 / 32 = 20 units/day.

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = 20 / 20 = 1 unit/day.

Work done by 8 women and 16 men in 1 day = (8 × 2) + (16 × 1)

Work done by 8 women and 16 men in 1 day = 16 + 16 = 32 units/day.

Time taken to complete the task = Total work / Work done per day.

⇒ Time = 640 / 32

⇒ Time = 20 days

**The time taken by 8 women and 16 men to complete the task is 20 days.**
